semantic.justification: Moves the actual existing General/Boolean/Text standard-entry generation fragment without changing its owners, provider/scanner calls or source format metadata. Boolean and Text now use original runtime keys99 and100, distinct from enum ordinals48 and49. The same compiled entries supply numeric/text output and its Text fallback. Numeric/date/time/currency/fraction builtin generation, general format compilation/output, converter modes and full CSV auto-input remain pending; this function is explicitly the consumed initial source generator phase, not a replacement for the full ImpGenerateFormats.
